description:
Give `ValidationReport` the provenance each finding needs and a selection operation, so every validation view can be computed as a filter of the one report.

## Background

- `ValidationReport` holds findings projected to the wire `ReportedFinding` (`crates/jit/src/validation/report.rs:23`), which keeps the attributed issue, rule, severity and message only. A view also needs each finding's origin (local rule, graph rule and whether it is repository-wide at transition, or a built-in pass), its firing subject (graph findings record it) and whether it is a configuration error.
- Today each view filters its own pipeline: per-issue at `crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1618-1658`, scope at `:1768-1887`, explain at `:1930-2022`, single rule in `rule_validation_report` (`:1063-1137`), and the gate checkers in `commands/gate_check.rs:450-601`.
- Scope membership comes from `domain::queries::bracket_scope_ids` (`crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs:443`) with the container template's breakdown type; rule selection errors come from `validation::graph::select_graph_rule` (`validation/graph.rs:479`); explain rows use `Selector::match_failure` and `render_selector` (`commands/validate.rs:2354-2373`, tests `:2912-2931`).
- The membership of each selection is fixed by the plan's `selection-membership` contract (`dev/active/9876a23a-one-validation-report/plan.md`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each report finding carries its origin, firing subject, attribution and configuration-error flag, and the wire projection is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: `ValidationReport::select(&Selection)` returns the wire `RuleReport` for `Whole`, `Issue`, `Scope` and `Rule` selections through one membership predicate, and `ValidationReport::explain` returns the `ExplainReport` for an issue; a prefix that resolves to no issue or to several fails with today's not-found or ambiguity error, and a report without parsed records fails every selection but `Whole` with its structural error.
- [hard] REQ-03: `render_selector` and the explain grouping live in the validation layer.
- [hard] REQ-04: Example unit tests show each selection's membership on one report, including the stated changes: a scope counts a coverage child outside the container's dependency closure, an issue selection omits a configuration error fired by another issue, and an issue selection omits `enforcement-drift` and keeps `rules-file`.

## Notes

- Behaviour changes, delivered to users as each view adopts the selection: scope rules see the whole repository; issue and explain configuration errors narrow to the selected issue's subject or rule; issue, explain, scope and rule selections report `rules-file` for an unloadable rule set; issue and explain selections never include `enforcement-drift`.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Validation views are selections of the report
